We ''are Rebels'' after all.''"<br />"''I like it. And I know Biggs would approve.|Wedge Antilles and Luke Skywalker, discussing the future of Stealth Squadron|<ref name="SW10" />}}
'''Stealth Squadron''',<ref name="SW7">[[Star Wars (2013) 7|''Star Wars'' (2013) 7]]</ref> originally known as '''Gray Flight''',<ref name="SW4" /> was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] formed shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SW2" /> The squadron was a secret squadron with only [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] knowing of their existence outside of the team's members. The squadron was tasked with discovering an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] infiltrated in the Alliance along with finding a suitable planet on which the alliance could set up a new base.<ref name="SW1">[[Star Wars (2013) 1|''Star Wars'' (2013) 1]]</ref>

Stealth Squadron pilots flew dark painted brand new [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]] provided by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] and considered clean of any [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]].<ref name="SW1" />

The squadron was led by [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] as her [[Executive officer/Legends|second-in-command]]. In addition to Organa and Antilles, the squadron included seven other [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] selected for their skills and loyalty.<ref name="SW2" />
